name: Reconciliation Checkpoint Safety Contract
purpose: 为 B35 Checkpoint 提供安全基础判断

safeToCheckpoint.condition: 允许保存当前状态 (可含 RECOVERY_REQUIRED 标记)
safeToCheckpoint.value: 始终为 true (checkpoint 可以保存安全和不安全状态)

safeToResume.condition: 允许从中断恢复并继续正常执行
safeToResume.value: 仅当 unresolvedHighSeverity=0 AND unknownOutcome=0 AND repairInProgress=false

unknownOutcome > 0.note: 未知结果未解决前禁止恢复
